facts.fact: RISA's Hanga Hubs page says the project established incubation hubs and runs a nine-month cohort programme (ideation, pre-incubation, incubation) for young entrepreneurs, listed as ongoing.
RISA says Hanga Hubs were set up in seven districts: Musanze, Rwamagana, Huye, Muhanga, Nyagatare, Rubavu and Rusizi.
